A.label: Research / Meta / data analysis / academic presentation

facts.text: 参与系统综述的检索与筛选，按既定纳排标准整理文献。
在指导下使用 R 完成 Meta 分析的数据整理与结果复核。
整理图表和汇报材料，向课题组进行学术汇报。
项目角色为参与者；未确认客户项目、用户访谈、产品需求、商业数据、外部 payer 或管理职责。

B.label: Clinical research / CRF / data quality / coordination / GCP

facts.text: 按既定研究方案参与病历筛查，并维护 CRF 和随访记录。
参与数据核对、缺失项跟进和数据质量整理。
完成 GCP 培训，并在研究团队内协调资料与时间节点。
项目角色为参与者；未确认运营 KPI、流程 owner、人员管理、独立中心管理或客户交付职责。

C.label: Wet lab / data analysis / project collaboration

facts.text: 在指导下参与细胞培养和 qPCR 实验，并记录实验条件。
使用 R 整理实验数据、生成基础图表，并协助结果复核。
与课题组成员协作完成实验资料整理和组会汇报。
项目角色为参与者；未确认销售、预算、商业数据库、收入预测、增长决策或团队管理职责。

jd_snapshot.title: Senior Product Manager
jd_snapshot.source_excerpt: Own product strategy, roadmap and outcomes; research provider and operational workflows; lead discovery through launch and iteration; partner with engineering and design; deliver measurable operational and provider outcomes.

mapping.jd_item: use data and research to understand workflows
mapping.boundary: clinical/research problem framing and result communication only; no user research
academic presentation does not prove product-squad collaboration
no requirements, PRD, roadmap, launch, metrics or ownership evidence

resume_wording: 参与系统综述的检索、筛选与证据整理；在指导下使用 R 支持 Meta 分析的数据处理和结果复核。
围绕明确的临床研究问题整理图表与学术汇报材料，支持课题组进行循证讨论与结果沟通。

final_audit.jd_language: pass: prioritization support and workflow-problem language only
final_audit.gaps: pass: roadmap, user research, launch and product experience explicit

jd_snapshot.title: Clinical Operations Manager
jd_snapshot.source_excerpt: Oversee multi-clinic operations, manage clinic teams, improve utilization and documentation metrics, implement workflows, lead process improvements, and support launches.

mapping.boundary: study workflow support, CRF and data-quality tasks; not clinic operations ownership

mapping.jd_item: manage teams, own KPIs and lead process improvement
mapping.boundary: no people management, KPI, operational metrics or process-owner evidence

resume_wording: 按既定研究方案参与病历筛查、CRF 维护与随访记录整理，支持研究资料的完整性与可追溯性。
参与数据核对和缺失项跟进，并在研究团队内协调资料与时间节点，支持既定研究流程执行。

final_audit.jd_language: pass: workflow and quality execution without manager framing
final_audit.gaps: pass: clinic leadership, KPI and process ownership explicit

jd_snapshot.title: Senior Consultant - Commercial Operations & Analytics
jd_snapshot.source_excerpt: Lead client deliverables and projects, advise on project direction, analyze data into actionable insights, manage client communications, and understand pharmaceutical commercial functions.

mapping.boundary: research evidence synthesis and academic reporting, not commercial consulting
presentation deliverable does not prove project management

mapping.jd_item: client delivery, advice and commercial analytics
mapping.boundary: no client, commercial data, client recommendation or project leadership evidence

resume_wording: 参与系统综述的文献检索、筛选与证据整理，并在指导下使用 R 支持 Meta 分析的数据处理和结果复核。
将分析结果整理为图表和结构化汇报材料，支持课题组对研究问题和证据的讨论。

final_audit.jd_language: pass: structured analysis and communication only
final_audit.gaps: pass: client delivery, advice and commercial context explicit
final_audit.usefulness: pass, but senior consultant fit is low

mapping.jd_item: data preparation, analysis and result communication

mapping.boundary: biomedical experimental data is not market, sales or commercial data

mapping.jd_item: market sizing, revenue forecasting, pricing and commercial decisions
mapping.boundary: no sales, budget, commercial dataset, forecast or decision evidence
